cards.source: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q1; key from PSC final answer key, Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I), 22-02-2019

learn.en: Stage carriage (Section 2(40)): carries more than 6 passengers, excluding the driver, for hire, with separate fares per passenger.

why.en: Like a private town bus — each passenger buys a ticket.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q1.

recall_q.en: A vehicle carrying more than 6 passengers (excluding driver) for hire, charging separate fares for each passenger or the whole journey, is a?

explain_simple.en: Stage carriage (Section 2(40)): carries more than 6 passengers, excluding the driver, for hire, with separate fares per passenger.

learn.en: Invalid carriage (Section 2(18)): a vehicle specially designed for a person with a physical defect or disability, used solely by that person.

why.en: The 2019 amendment uses 'adapted vehicle' for the DL class.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q2.

recall_q.en: A motor vehicle specially built for a person with a physical defect or disability is?

explain_simple.en: Invalid carriage (Section 2(18)): a vehicle specially designed for a person with a physical defect or disability, used solely by that person.

learn.en: Public service vehicle (Section 2(35)): any vehicle carrying passengers for hire or reward — maxi cab, motor cab, contract carriage, stage carriage.

why.en: It serves the paying public.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q4.

recall_q.en: A vehicle used or adapted to carry passengers for hire or reward is a?

explain_simple.en: Public service vehicle (Section 2(35)): any vehicle carrying passengers for hire or reward — maxi cab, motor cab, contract carriage, stage carriage.

learn.en: Transport vehicle (Section 2(47)) = public service vehicle, goods carriage, educational institution bus or private service vehicle.

why.en: These need special licences, permits and fitness checks.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q5.

recall_q.en: ___ means a public service vehicle, goods carriage, educational institution bus or private service vehicle.

explain_simple.en: Transport vehicle (Section 2(47)) = public service vehicle, goods carriage, educational institution bus or private service vehicle.

learn.en: Route (Section 2(38)): a line of travel which specifies the highway a vehicle may travel between one terminus and another.

why.en: Stage carriage permits are given for routes.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q6.

recall_q.en: A line of travel showing the highway between two termini is a?

explain_simple.en: Route (Section 2(38)): a line of travel which specifies the highway a vehicle may travel between one terminus and another.

learn.en: Category M = passenger vehicles with at least 4 wheels. Category N = goods vehicles with at least 4 wheels. L = two/three-wheelers.

why.en: M for 'man' (people), N for goods.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q7.

recall_q.en: A motor vehicle with at least four wheels for carrying passengers is category?

explain_simple.en: Category M = passenger vehicles with at least 4 wheels. Category N = goods vehicles with at least 4 wheels. L = two/three-wheelers.

learn.en: N1: goods vehicle up to 3.5 t GVW. N2: 3.5–12 t. N3: above 12 t.

why.en: The number grows with weight.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q8.

recall_q.en: A goods vehicle with GVW not exceeding 3.5 tonnes is category?

explain_simple.en: N1: goods vehicle up to 3.5 t GVW. N2: 3.5–12 t. N3: above 12 t.

learn.en: An appeal against a licensing authority's order (refusal, disqualification) is filed within 30 days of receiving the order (Section 17/19).

why.en: A short time limit keeps cases moving.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q9.

recall_q.en: A person aggrieved by a licensing authority's order may appeal within?

explain_simple.en: An appeal against a licensing authority's order (refusal, disqualification) is filed within 30 days of receiving the order (Section 17/19).

learn.en: An International Driving Permit (IDP) lets an Indian licence holder drive in other countries (Section 2(19A), Chapter II).

why.en: Foreign countries accept it with the Indian licence.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q10.

recall_q.en: A licence issued to an Indian to drive abroad is the?

explain_simple.en: An International Driving Permit (IDP) lets an Indian licence holder drive in other countries (Section 2(19A), Chapter II).

learn.en: A transport vehicle licence needs at least 1 year of holding a light motor vehicle licence.

why.en: Experience with cars comes before buses and lorries.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q12.

why.en: A conductor must be an adult to handle passengers and cash.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q13.

learn.en: No one under 20 years may drive a transport vehicle (Section 4).

why.en: Heavier vehicles need older, more mature drivers.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q14.

recall_q.en: Minimum age to drive a transport vehicle?

explain_simple.en: No one under 20 years may drive a transport vehicle (Section 4).

learn.en: In Kerala, the Regional Transport Officer (RTO) is the licensing authority for the region; the Joint RTO is the additional licensing authority.

why.en: Licences are issued from RTO and Sub-RTO offices.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q15.

recall_q.en: The licensing authority of a region is the?

explain_simple.en: In Kerala, the Regional Transport Officer (RTO) is the licensing authority for the region; the Joint RTO is the additional licensing authority.

learn.en: Section 3: no person shall drive a motor vehicle in any public place without an effective driving licence.

why.en: Public places are where others can be hurt.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q17.

recall_q.en: No person shall drive a motor vehicle in any ___ without an effective driving licence.

learn.en: M2: 9+ seats besides driver, GVW up to 5 t (minibus). M3: same but GVW above 5 t (bus). M1: up to 8 seats besides driver.

why.en: Bigger GVW, bigger number.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q19.

recall_q.en: Passenger vehicle with 9 or more seats plus driver, GVW not over 5 tonnes, is category?

explain_simple.en: M2: 9+ seats besides driver, GVW up to 5 t (minibus). M3: same but GVW above 5 t (bus). M1: up to 8 seats besides driver.

learn.en: A battery two-wheeler with top speed below 25 km/h (and low power and weight) is not treated as a motor vehicle — no registration or licence needed.

why.en: Very slow e-bikes are treated like bicycles.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q20.

recall_q.en: A battery-operated two-wheeler is not a 'motor vehicle' if its maximum speed is?

explain_simple.en: A battery two-wheeler with top speed below 25 km/h (and low power and weight) is not treated as a motor vehicle — no registration or licence needed.

learn.en: On sale of a vehicle, the seller (transferor) reports the transfer within 14 days; the buyer (transferee) within 30 days (Section 50).

why.en: Seller 14, buyer 30.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q27.

recall_q.en: On transfer of ownership within the same state, the transferor must report within?

explain_simple.en: On sale of a vehicle, the seller (transferor) reports the transfer within 14 days; the buyer (transferee) within 30 days (Section 50).

learn.en: The buyer (transferee) must report the transfer within 30 days (Section 50).

why.en: The registration must show the real owner.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q28.

recall_q.en: On transfer of ownership, the transferee must report to the registering authority within?

explain_simple.en: The buyer (transferee) must report the transfer within 30 days (Section 50).

learn.en: Moving to another state is no reason to cancel registration — it gets a new mark (Section 47). Cancel only if destroyed, taken out of India or falsely registered (Section 55).

why.en: The vehicle is still in India and still registered.

example.en: Asked in: Kerala PSC test paper — Motor Vehicles Act (Paper I) — 2019 (Q.P. MV Act Paper I, 2019-02-22), Q29.

recall_q.en: Cancellation of registration is NOT possible when the vehicle is?

why.en: Permits control where and how commercial vehicles operate.
